title: Linux_Remaiten_Botnet_Investigation_f37
description: Investigate and respond to a botnet incident involving the Linux/Remaiten malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
Access the sandbox via SSH using the following credentials:

Host: bot1
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano

Enter the passkey 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario. If you need to access locally, use the following credentials:

Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano

Enter the passkey 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Unauthorized Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections. Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and are making external connections.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and are making external connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The service name might include 'bot' and be related to beaconing activity.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Traffic Service
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.
levels.solution: Examine network connections and service logs for unusual traffic patterns. Look for services that are generating a high volume of traffic.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and service logs for unusual traffic patterns.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are generating a high volume of traffic.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The service name might include 'bot' and be related to flooding activity.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Investigate systemd services and timers. Look for services that are set to start automatically on boot.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are set to start automatically on boot.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The timer name might include 'update' and be related to system updates.
